bagPolicy.summary: The A–Z guide permits clear bags up to 10 × 10 inches; the separate house policy also lists small bags smaller than 10 × 10 inches and fanny packs. Backpacks and larger bags are prohibited; because the descriptions differ, bring a clear bag smaller than 10 × 10 inches.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue’s lots are behind the building off Michigan Avenue between 24th and 25th Streets; advance passes may be sold, and rates depend on the show.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue directions and A–Z guide do not specify a dedicated rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Cashless bars sell drinks; some indoor and outdoor summer events host food trucks, and selected events have pizza upstairs. Outside food and drinks are not permitted.

accessibility.summary: For accessible seating, email the box office or call 414-342-7283 before the concert.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are picked up at the box office during its hours with photo ID matching the order; staff may also ask for the payment card.
